# Fizlet

> Fizlet™ (fzlt™) is the bricks for DOM animation and games, by Chris Cooley: a game or an animation boils down to logic and style, from a prompt. Every brick has a gzip budget in CI, there are no runtime dependencies, and the page always comes back.

The whole API, every export of every brick with its signature, doc comment and status, in plain text: [llms-full.txt](https://fizlet.com/llms-full.txt)

## Pages

- [Fizlet · Building blocks for DOM animation and games](https://fizlet.com/): Fizlet™: building blocks for DOM animation and games, kept for performance, so you bring only logic and style. Kernel 3.3 KB gzip, no dependencies.
- [Brand: Fizlet™ marks, lockups and colour · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/brand/): The Fizlet™ and fzlt™ marks, lockups, ™ and casing rules, clear space, colour tokens and the Board UI kit, live, with every mark as an SVG download.
- [Kernel and bricks: every module and its size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/): Every Fizlet module with its API and its measured size: the kernel is 3.3 KB gzip, each brick its own import.
- [Daily contest: top picks, weekly winners · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/contest/): The Fizlet Daily contest: up to 40 entries a day, the top 1 to 5 picked, a weekly and a monthly winner; over 10,240 B live can't win.
- [Cookies and storage: none until you say yes · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/cookies/): Every cookie and storage key fizlet.com may use, what each holds, how long it lasts, and how to change your choice or clear them.
- [Docs: the contract, the loop, Recall, budgets · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/docs/): How Fizlet's kernel and bricks work: getting started, the nine-rule contract, the loop, Recall, size budgets and determinism, with numbers from v0.27.0.
- [Quick start: ten lines to a blast · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/examples/quick-start.html): Ten lines to a blast: the Fizlet quick start, running as is. Click the board; scroll it away and the engine pauses, switch tabs and it stops.
- [Daily: tiny examples, made every day · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/gallery/): Tiny Fizlet examples, logic and style on the bricks, made daily as a contest: 122 so far, each live with its size measured on this build.
- [Daily Hi-Fi: bigger pieces, their own lane · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/gallery/hifi/): The bigger Fizlet Daily pieces (41): dioramas, 2.5D, mini-games and heroes, with their own weekly winner and sizes measured on this build.
- [Daily, page 2: tiny examples, made every day · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/gallery/page/2/): Fizlet Daily page 2 of 6: older tiny examples by theme, each with its brief, its live demo and its size measured on this build.

- [Make one: a prompt in, a snippet out · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/make/): Type a prompt, get a drop-in Fizlet animation: one file, only the bricks it uses, its size measured in your browser. No server, no tracking.
- [News: every Fizlet release, newest first · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/news/): Release notes for all 51 Fizlet versions, newest first, from the changelog: new bricks, fixes and the sizes measured when each shipped.

- [Privacy policy: analytics only with consent · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/privacy/): What fizlet.com collects, why and for how long: no analytics, hosting logs, and how to opt out. No ads, no selling data.

## Docs

- [Authoring with Fizlet: the shape and three recipes](https://fizlet.com/docs/authoring/): How to write any Fizlet piece, which bricks to pick by use, and three recipes that run as is: an action on the page, a shooter and two players, measured.
- [Fizlet size budgets: every module, measured](https://fizlet.com/docs/budgets/): Every Fizlet module's gzip size and budget, measured on this build the way CI checks it: a kernel under 4 KB, a page build under 7 KB, heroes under 10.
- [The Fizlet contract: nine tested rules](https://fizlet.com/docs/contract/): One clock, bounded pools, zero steady-state allocation, change-only writes, pause by default, Recall: the nine rules every Fizlet brick keeps, each tested.
- [Deterministic games in Fizlet: seeds and lockstep](https://fizlet.com/docs/determinism/): Make a Fizlet sim replay from a seed: fixed step, seeded random, typed arrays and input bits. syncCheck finds the first frame where two peers differ.
- [Getting started with Fizlet: a DOM game engine](https://fizlet.com/docs/getting-started/): Install Fizlet with one script tag or ES modules, start an engine, and give the page back with destroy(). The kernel is under 4 KB gzip, no dependencies.
- [The Fizlet loop: fixed step, one shared rAF](https://fizlet.com/docs/loop/): How Fizlet runs a frame: read, step and render phases, a fixed 60 Hz step with a catch-up cap, auto-pause, settle and an fps cap for page heroes.
- [Recall: how Fizlet gives the page back](https://fizlet.com/docs/recall/): Fizlet's ledger records every DOM change: change-only writes, an exact restore on destroy(), and a newer edit by the host page always wins.

## Guides

- [Fill an Astro animation slot with a Fizlet scene](https://fizlet.com/guides/astro-slot/): Fill an Astro page engine slot with @fzlt/core/slot: loads near the viewport, skips reduced motion, settles to zero frames, keeps the text alternative.
- [Build your own room server for Fizlet multiplayer](https://fizlet.com/guides/build-your-own-room-server/): The wire protocol @fzlt/core/presence speaks, as a contract: 12-byte lockstep messages, seats, lobby, resume, one room per object, a threat checklist.
- [Build a micro game with Fizlet in one file](https://fizlet.com/guides/micro-game/): A step-by-step Fizlet guide: a canvas click game with typed-array state, a fixed 60 Hz step, pooled effects, a change-only HUD and Recall on Escape.
- [Port an existing game onto the Fizlet kernel](https://fizlet.com/guides/port-a-game/): Move a DOM or canvas game onto Fizlet step by step: one shared loop, writes through the ledger, a seeded step and typed arrays, measured before and after.

## Bricks

- [@fzlt/core/actor: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/actor.html): @fzlt/core/actor: Units, bots, turrets and shots as data. API and measured size (908 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/aim: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/aim.html): @fzlt/core/aim: Where bots and turrets point and when they may fire. API and measured size (691 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/announce: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/announce.html): @fzlt/core/announce: Game events read out to screen readers through one polite live region, rate-limited. API and measured size (612 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/arcade: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/arcade.html): @fzlt/core/arcade: The shell every page arcade game repeats, so a game is only its rules and its art. API and measured size (24145 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/beam: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/beam.html): @fzlt/core/beam: Lasers on a board. API and measured size (4388 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/board-page: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/board-page.html): @fzlt/core/board-page: The host page as the board. API and measured size (4104 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/camera: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/camera.html): @fzlt/core/camera: The page is the camera. API and measured size (1400 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/cards: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/cards.html): @fzlt/core/cards: A deck of cards for tabletop games. API and measured size (3383 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/coach: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/coach.html): @fzlt/core/coach: The hints and tutorial layer the board games share, in three small parts. API and measured size (1220 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/collide: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/collide.html): @fzlt/core/collide: A fixed-capacity spatial hash (no allocation per insert or query) and the shape tests games need. API and measured size (1265 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/css-clock: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/css-clock.html): @fzlt/core/css-clock: A page's own CSS @keyframes, on the kernel clock. API and measured size (5368 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/debug: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/debug.html): @fzlt/core/debug: Development-only checks. API and measured size (1133 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/dice: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/dice.html): @fzlt/core/dice: Seeded dice for tabletop games. API and measured size (4262 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/diorama: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/diorama.html): @fzlt/core/diorama: Software 3D for cutaway tabletop scenes, drawn on a 2D canvas you own. API and measured size (7258 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/drive: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/drive.html): @fzlt/core/drive: Vehicle feel on a heightfield, for diorama racing and trail games. API and measured size (5262 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/embed: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/embed.html): @fzlt/core/embed: Drop a game onto any page with one small config. API and measured size (2040 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/flick: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/flick.html): @fzlt/core/flick: Light tabletop physics for diorama pieces. API and measured size (5410 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/fx: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/fx.html): @fzlt/core/fx: Explosions that land. API and measured size (2792 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/grid: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/grid.html): @fzlt/core/grid: The game board. A cols × rows tile grid in typed arrays. API and measured size (1652 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/hud: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/hud.html): @fzlt/core/hud: Change-only HUD bindings that never allocate in the steady state. API and measured size (1306 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/input: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/input.html): @fzlt/core/input: One controller for keys, pointer and a touch stick, mapped to named intents. API and measured size (1909 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/kernel.html): @fzlt/core: The kernel: one loop, bounded work, and the page always comes back. API and measured size (3372 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/layout: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/layout.html): @fzlt/core/layout: Force-directed layout on typed arrays, with a Barnes-Hut pass, for diagrams and graphs that settle. API and measured size (1745 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/match: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/match.html): @fzlt/core/match: The match flow every game shares, intro → count → play → paused → end. API and measured size (2617 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/math: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/math.html): @fzlt/core/math: Trig that gives the same bits on every engine, for anything that steps a sim. API and measured size (1746 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/pad: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/pad.html): @fzlt/core/pad: Swappable on-screen controls for touch (and mouse). API and measured size (2068 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/perf: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/perf.html): @fzlt/core/perf: A live performance overlay for players, off until they switch it on. API and measured size (2019 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/presence: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/presence.html): @fzlt/core/presence: Lockstep input exchange for multiplayer, behind a tiny transport adapter. API and measured size (2197 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/props: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/props.html): @fzlt/core/props: A kit of small low-poly models for @fzlt/core/diorama scenes, so a new diorama starts furnished. API and measured size (3115 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/rules: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/rules.html): @fzlt/core/rules: The rules every arcade game repeats, as three small systems on the kernel. API and measured size (1318 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/scene: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/scene.html): @fzlt/core/scene: An animation recipe as data. API and measured size (8369 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/slot: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/slot.html): @fzlt/core/slot: Mount a Fizlet scene into an Astro page engine slot. API and measured size (1849 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/sound: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/sound.html): @fzlt/core/sound: The sound adapter. API and measured size (1062 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/sprite: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/sprite.html): @fzlt/core/sprite: The character layer's drawing primitive. API and measured size (1437 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/steer: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/steer.html): @fzlt/core/steer: How things move toward, away from and around a point, as DOM-free steering on typed arrays. API and measured size (2759 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/terrain: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/terrain.html): @fzlt/core/terrain: A heightfield for diorama scenes. API and measured size (5566 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/timeline: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/timeline.html): @fzlt/core/timeline: Scripted DOM choreography on the kernel clock. API and measured size (2137 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/touch: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/touch.html): @fzlt/core/touch: Taps and swipes on an animation or a game never zoom or pan the page. API and measured size (310 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/track: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/track.html): @fzlt/core/track: Board paths for roll-and-move games. API and measured size (2055 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/ui: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/ui.html): @fzlt/core/ui: The tiny behaviour half of board-ui.css. API and measured size (2907 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/view-canvas: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/view-canvas.html): @fzlt/core/view-canvas: One overlay canvas per root. API and measured size (936 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/view-dom: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/view-dom.html): @fzlt/core/view-dom: A @fzlt/core/actor table drawn as DOM nodes, one per row, pooled. API and measured size (882 B gzip).
- [@fzlt/core/water: API and measured size · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/bricks/water.html): @fzlt/core/water: Animated water for @fzlt/core/diorama scenes. API and measured size (5264 B gzip).

## Notes

- [Before AI: 2015, three micro animations · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/notes/before-ai-2015/): Three CSS sprite micro animations Chris Cooley drew by hand in 2015, recovered from the Wayback Machine, remade in Fizlet, then turned into an arcade.
- [How small is small: Fizlet's sizes · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/notes/how-small-is-small/): Fizlet's kernel is 3,413 B gzip against a 4 KB budget. Every brick's size, the 10 KB hero budget, and how CI and this site measure them the same way.
- [Lockstep multiplayer in a few KB · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/notes/lockstep-multiplayer-in-a-few-kb/): @fzlt/core/presence is 1,834 B gzip: lockstep inputs, 12 bytes a message, a hash check every 30 frames, and how to build a room server like ours.
- [Moving the games onto a 4 KB kernel · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/notes/moving-the-games-onto-a-4-kb-kernel/): Four games on Fizlet's 4 KB kernel: each grew 7 to 21% in gzip bytes. Every byte, why it is there, and what the shared engine bought.
- [Recall: how Fizlet gives the page back · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/notes/recall-the-page-always-comes-back/): Fizlet writes every DOM change through one ledger: change-only, a newer host edit wins, and destroy() restores the page exactly. How, and how it's tested.
- [Why fzlt: the short mark of Fizlet, the DOM engine](https://fizlet.com/notes/why-fzlt/): fzlt is Fizlet's short mark and npm scope: no vowels, a z, nothing autocorrects into it. Install Fizlet with npm i @fzlt/core.

## Demos and examples

- [Before AI: 2015, three sprites live · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/demos/before-ai-2015/): Three CSS sprite animations Chris Cooley drew by hand in 2015, live beside a Fizlet remake and an arcade version, taken apart with bricks and sizes.
- [Fizz: crack the can, hear the fizz · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/demos/fizz/): An arcade soda can crunches, pops and sprays fizz out of its card, seen from the side and from the top. 8665 B gzip live chunk, by Chris Cooley.
- [Layers: a game is a stack, each layer one brick · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/demos/layers/): A game is a stack of layers. Battlefield Blitz fans out into its bricks, one faults, gets patched, and folds back.
- [Fizlet → fzlt: the name shift · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/demos/name-shift/): The launch logo: FIZ and LET go into a press and come out as fzlt, then build a wall of bricks. 5,726 B gzip live, still once it ends. By Chris Cooley.
- [Origin: Code. Sleep. Drink. Repeat. · Fizlet](https://fizlet.com/demos/origin/): A day as a loop: sleep, sunrise, headphones, coffee, code, night. The 2015 props alive in 35,611 B gzip. By Chris Cooley.
- [Crack the can: the fizz as a Fizlet hero](https://fizlet.com/examples/fizz/): The fizz as a hero on any page: tap the pixel soda can, it crunches, pops and sprays out of its card. A Fizlet example by Chris Cooley.
